title: Flow State Retreat
short_description: A 5-Day Yoga & Somatics Reset for Your Body, Nervous System & Energy
description:
Picture yourself waking up with the first rays of autumn sun filtering through linen curtains and warming your skin.

The room is quiet. Outside, you hear birds singing, the kind of sound that settles your whole system before you even open your eyes.

You walk barefoot to the terrace with a warm cup of coffee or herbal tea, observing the trees and the birds in the forest that surrounds you. The morning is slow. There’s no one asking for you. No notifications. Nowhere else to be.

You begin your day with conscious movement that feels good in your body, not another task on your to-do list, but something you actually want to do.

You’ll laugh with women you met just days ago, yet somehow feel like you’ve known for years.

You’ll enjoy the warmth of Portugal’s south coast. You’ll surf, rest, journal, move and stargaze under clear October skies.

You’ll remember what it feels like to live from presence — instead of rush or pressure.

This is Flow State Retreat.

An experience designed to help your nervous system recalibrate.
Where movement, rest, play and connection bring you back into regulation.

Where your body feels safe enough to slow down and strong enough to expand.

[More information & booking](https://www.catarinaamaralyoga.com/flowstateretreat)
